tasks.title: Notify adopts the fixed contract while retaining its existing hostile-input guards
tasks.spec: ## Repository: notify, Shared finding, all Behavior bullets and Completion evidence; Rollout order step 2, Security impact and Acceptance evidence (whole feature) 4. After contract merges, record or verify/reuse the same full merged main SHA as the other consumers. Preserve #553's noRedirect and capture wrappers, fixed apiError texts, URL redaction and rejected-item handling; document that the shared client now also protects redirects and compressed responses under Bun.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; lint, typecheck, full tests and unchanged 80% line-coverage gate pass, including unchanged test/api-hostile.test.ts, test/api-limits.test.ts and test/security-review.test.ts. Existing redirect, hostile-response/log-redaction and body-limit assertions remain green.

acceptance.command: git diff --exit-code main -- src test/api-hostile.test.ts test/api-limits.test.ts test/security-review.test.ts
acceptance.expected: exit 0 with no output: production guards and the named security regressions are unchanged.

acceptance.command: git diff main -- package.json bun.lock docs/operation.md
acceptance.expected: package.json changes only the contract pin to the same full merged contract main SHA containing #864/version 2.5.2 adopted by the other consumers, verified against main and the shared finding; bun.lock agrees. Operation docs say the shared client also refuses redirects and compressed responses under Bun and notify keeps its own redirect manual wrapper.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && gh pr view --json body,statusCheckRollup
acceptance.expected: Whitespace and required CI checks pass. PR records full merged SHA/finding provenance, required-check results including unchanged hostile-input suites, empty src diff and applicable Security impact evidence for retained secret-safe logs, redirect protection, body limits and full-SHA/lockfile consistency. Pin adoption adds no runtime dependency or setting and removes none of #553's guards.
